BiblicalUsage: The Old Testament word çâʻad means to support, to uphold. It appears 12 times, and the passages that use it — 1 Kings and Genesis among them — show it in its natural setting. Read them together and the meaning settles itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God chose çâʻad on purpose. To support, to uphold is not an accident of language; it is the way He says what He means.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
